statements.t: Our business results have been, or are expected to be, impacted by several trends and strategic activities, which are described below.
We expect that the trends described below may continue to impact our results of operations, cash flows, and financial position.
We do not expect Legacy Search revenue to return to historical levels, and it may decline further.

To the extent we are successful in accelerating IntentKey revenue and that IntentKey becomes a larger portion of our overall revenue mix, we expect that direct operating margins will also increase, as Audience Modeling has historically yielded higher direct operating margins than our Legacy Search business.
We will pay Wainwright a commission rate of up to 3.0% of the aggregate gross proceeds from each sale.

We will not make any sales of Common Shares pursuant to the ATM Agreement, unless and until a new prospectus is filed and the expiration of a 180-day lockup period following completion of the Offerings.

We have focused our resources behind a plan to market our collective multi-channel advertising capabilities differentiated by our AI technology, the IntentKey, where we have a technological advantage and higher margins.
If we are successful in implementing our plan, we expect to return to and maintain positive cash flows from operations.
However, there is no assurance that we will be able to achieve this objective.

While these initiatives are intended to strengthen the Company's liquidity position and support its ongoing operations, there can be no assurance that additional financing will be available on acceptable terms, that planned operating improvements will be achieved, or that these measures will generate sufficient liquidity to meet the Company's obligations as they become due.

The accompanying condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis, which assumes the Company will continue to realize its assets and discharge its liabilities in the normal course of business.

We elected the fair value option for the Streeterville Notes and estimate their fair value using a Monte Carlo simulation model that incorporates significant unobservable inputs, including discount rates, probability of default, recovery rates, stock price volatility, and the expected timing of redemptions.
